blocks.title: Evaluation
blocks.body: Start with demand fit, product condition, and peer alternatives (Grand Hyatt, Hyatt Centric, Hyatt Place, Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, and Westin). Decide whether Hyatt Regency's core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth is the right lane before detailed conversion capital is committed.

blocks.title: Conversion Design
blocks.body: Translate Hyatt Regency positioning into rooms, public space, service, and technology workstreams that match the intended core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth. Sequence design, systems, and capital milestones with financing and operator decisions so conversion scope stays underwritable. Keep Hyatt Regency product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

blocks.title: Pre-Opening
blocks.body: Coordinate World of Hyatt readiness, training, staffing, and commercial launch with product completion for Hyatt Regency. Clarify owner, operator, and brand responsibilities before opening so the guest promise is deliverable from day one. Keep Hyatt Regency product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

blocks.title: Opening
blocks.body: Launch with the Hyatt Regency guest promise consistently expressed across service and channels while platform systems stabilize. Keep escalation paths clear for the first operating weeks and verify quality readiness against the intended core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth.

blocks.title: Ramp-Up
blocks.body: Use early guest feedback and channel mix to refine delivery of the core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth. Watch whether staffing and public-space programming actually support the intended Hyatt Regency promise, and adjust operator execution before assuming affiliation value is fully realized.

blocks.title: Ongoing
blocks.body: Maintain Hyatt Regency product discipline while meeting applicable platform quality and commercial obligations. Revisit capital and operator alignment as the hotel stabilizes so Hyatt Regency remains credible versus peer alternatives such as Grand Hyatt. Keep Hyatt Regency product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

blocks.title: What Owners Are Buying
blocks.body: Owners evaluating Hyatt Regency are buying a core upper-upscale full-service brand with meetings and group depth backed by Hyatt Hotels Corporation distribution and World of Hyatt. The practical case is Underwrite Hyatt Regency as Hyatt’s core upper-upscale full-service meetings brand—never as Grand Hyatt prestige intensity, Centric lifestyle exploration, or Hyatt Place select-service economics..

blocks.title: Meetings-Led Upper-Upscale Full-Service Hotels
blocks.body: Hyatt Regency fits owners with credible meeting inventory and full-service public space who need World of Hyatt reach without Grand Hyatt prestige capital or Centric lifestyle design intensity.

blocks.title: Convention Airport And Corporate Corridor Depth
blocks.body: Convention-adjacent, airport, and corporate corridor sites create Regency value when group and transient demand share a productive full-service plant. Do not underwrite Hyatt Place select-service economics as if they were Regency.

blocks.title: Full-Service Conversion Without Lifestyle Drift
blocks.body: Conversions work when an existing full-service box can deliver Regency’s meetings-capable promise. Value erodes if sponsors import Centric explorer language, Grand Hyatt luxury ritual, or Marriott Hotels / Sheraton generic full-service copy.

blocks.title: Operating Intensity Between Select Service And Grand
blocks.body: Regency’s owner case sits above Hyatt Place and below Grand Hyatt. Staff F&B and meetings honestly so affiliation matches real demand rather than a select-service box or a prestige flagship.

blocks.title: Key Watchouts
blocks.body:
Do not underwrite Hyatt Regency like a lower-ladder sibling with thinner product capital.
Confirm fee / management exhibits before IC—Factory does not invent undisclosed rates.
World of Hyatt drives demand but adds loyalty chargebacks—model net contribution.
Operator capability must match brand QA intensity for this flag.

blocks.title: Owner Considerations
blocks.body: Sponsor capability, operator fit, and disclosure discipline matter more than flag prestige. Hyatt Regency application, royalty, marketing, loyalty, and PIP — Confirm current franchise disclosure / FDD exhibits for application, royalty, marketing, loyalty, and PIP. Distinguish historical FDD figures from the live agreement. Amounts are not staged without a verified disclosure.

blocks.title: Commercial Theme
blocks.body: Versus Grand Hyatt / Park Hyatt luxury peers, Regency is upscale full-service meetings; versus Hyatt Place select-service, it requires full-service capital—model from current Hyatt agreements.

blocks.title: Data & Analytics
blocks.body: Parent revenue and CRM analytics support Hyatt Regency where connected—property teams still own local competitive response.

blocks.title: International Demand
blocks.body: International feed depends on World of Hyatt awareness and source-market airlift—do not assume global portfolio strength equals this hotel's inbound mix.

blocks.title: Leisure & Destination
blocks.body: Leisure fit follows whether Hyatt Regency's product matches destination seasonality and amenity expectations.

blocks.title: Reputation & QA
blocks.body: Guest scores and brand QA affect ranking in World of Hyatt search and account eligibility—budget reputation management.

blocks.title: Sales & Catering
blocks.body: Group and catering contribution depends on meeting product and parent sales coverage for this flag—confirm before underwriting group-heavy IC.

blocks.title: Middle East & Africa
blocks.body: Confirm MEA openings/pipeline for Hyatt Regency—do not extrapolate from sibling flags.

blocks.title: Asia Pacific
blocks.body: Confirm APAC scale and growth posture for Hyatt Regency from parent disclosures.

blocks.title: Recent Momentum
blocks.body: Confirm recent Hyatt Regency openings and signings from Hyatt Hotels Corporation newsrooms—Factory does not invent opening lists.

blocks.title: Brand / Development Page
blocks.body: Public brand and development references for Hyatt Regency. Confirm current PDFs and fee exhibits with Hyatt Hotels Corporation development—do not treat this page as a fee schedule.

blocks.title: Loyalty Program Reference
blocks.body: Official World of Hyatt rules and tier charts — confirm earn/redeem before IC.

blocks.title: Dealality Insight
blocks.body: Hyatt Regency fits owners who can fund full-service meetings with World of Hyatt; wrong when capital only supports Hyatt Place or when sponsors invent royalty tables.
